
```{r}
se_filtered <- function(vals) {
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  sd(vals) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

se <- function(vals) {
  sd(vals) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

mean_filtered <- function(vals) {
  mean(vals[is.finite(vals)])
}

all_results <- all_results |>
  mutate(
    adjusted.rand_row = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_row),
    adjusted.rand_col_true = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_col_true),
    adjusted.rand_col = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_col)
  )
  
squash_trials <- all_results |>
  group_by(p, extra_dim, algorithm) |>
  summarise(across(feature_recall:col_ch, list(mean=mean, se=se)))

plot_methods <- function(metric, label=metric) {
  ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=extra_dim, y=.data[[paste0(metric, "_mean")]], color=algorithm)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[paste0(metric, "_mean")]] - 1.96 * .data[[paste0(metric, "_se")]],
                  ymax = .data[[paste0(metric, "_mean")]] + 1.96 * .data[[paste0(metric, "_se")]],
                  fill = algorithm),
              alpha = 0.25, linetype = "blank") + 
  labs(y = label, x = "Extra Noisy Features") + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 900, 100)) + 
  theme_minimal()
}

plot_methods("adjusted.rand_row", "Row ARI")
ggsave("~/BCBC/simulated_experiments/figures/row_ari.png")

plot_methods("adjusted.rand_col_true", "True Column ARI")
ggsave("~/BCBC/simulated_experiments/figures/true_col_ari.png")

plot_methods("adjusted.rand_col", "All Column ARI")
ggsave("~/BCBC/simulated_experiments/figures/col_ari.png")

plot_methods("true_err", "Error")
plot_methods("feature_f1", "F1 Score")
plot_methods("row_silhouette")
plot_methods("col_silhouette")

```


```{r}
ggplot(all_results |>
         filter(grepl("BCBC", algorithm)) |>
         filter(extra_dim > 0),
       aes(x=factor(extra_dim), y=feature_auc, color=algorithm)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(y = "AUC Score", x = "Extra Noisy Features") + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("~/BCBC/simulated_experiments/figures/auc.png")
```

```{r}

all_results_SNR <- all_results_SNR |>
  mutate(
    adjusted.rand_row = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_row),
    adjusted.rand_col_true = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_col_true),
    adjusted.rand_col = pmax(0, adjusted.rand_col)
  )

squash_trials_SNR <- all_results_SNR |>
  group_by(p, noise_level, n, algorithm) |>
  summarise(across(feature_recall:col_ch, list(mean=mean, se=se)))

```

```{r}

ggplot(squash_trials_SNR, aes(x = factor(n), y = factor(noise_level))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = adjusted.rand_row_mean)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(adjusted.rand_row_mean, digits = 3))) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("(", round(adjusted.rand_row_se, digits = 3), ")")), nudge_y = -0.25, size=2) +
  labs("sigma", "Samples", fill="Row ARI") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(breaks=seq(0, 1, 0.15)) +
  facet_wrap(~algorithm) +
  theme_minimal()
  
  

ggplot(all_results_SNR, aes(x = factor(noise_level), y = adjusted.rand_row)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color=factor(algorithm))) +
  facet_wrap(~n)

ggplot(squash_trials_SNR, aes(x = noise_level, y = adjusted.rand_col_mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(color=factor(algorithm))) +
  facet_wrap(~n)

ggplot(all_results_SNR, aes(x = adjusted.rand_row, y = adjusted.rand_col_true)) +
  geom_point(aes(color=factor(algorithm), shape=factor(noise_level))) +
  facet_wrap(~n)

```
